public_delta.note: Reuse the existing Form compiled fields, source/render guards, value projection, draft/error state and typed choice owners. Whole hooks observe Rows snapshots and ignore ordinary return values; selected refresh never changes RowId or commits/validates inputs. No new data owner, registry or lifecycle module.

whole_row_observers.outcome: Add synchronous beforeBind/onBind observers around explicit nonnull bind, full current-row refresh and current-live-row revert. Supply readonly root, immutable complete raw RowSnapshot<T> including unbound keys and original revert event or null for explicit calls. Ignore ordinary results including false; reject/drain thenables and report FORM_BIND API/hook/row/cause.
whole_row_observers.remaining: Local/shared/global hook/default composition, per-unbound-key observation and complete row lifecycle parity remain required.

ordering_and_lifecycle.outcome: Run before before association/DOM/visible-issue changes; then preserve existing full render/value/draft/error ordering and invoke after only for the current completed synchronous pass. Revert source and draft invalidation are already committed; failures do not roll them back. Guard source identity, render generation and disposal; allow completed different-row nested binds, reject active same-row/cyclic hook entry, drain async returns even after supersession, and release guards after failures. A private Field/RowId renderer marker rejects same-pair/cross-field selected recursion with UI_RENDER (wrapped by FORM_BIND if it propagates through a whole hook), restores its prior value in finally and preserves nonrecursive whole-hook selection and different-row nested binding.
ordering_and_lifecycle.remaining: Application side effects are not transactional. After means the synchronous pass finished; focused editable value projection may wait for blur. No new generic lifecycle engine or full-family closure is claimed.

same_id_selected_refresh.outcome: Refresh exact existing compiled field paths without changing RowId, parsing/committing/validating inputs or clearing any retained drafts/issues. Preflight the entire array, reject unknown/nonstring names, deduplicate, use compiled DOM order and keep groups atomic. Empty selection is a disposal-checked no-op except existing completed local reset work. Selecting every field still suppresses whole hooks.
same_id_selected_refresh.remaining: Dynamic field add/remove rediscovery, cross-row partial binding and all remaining general selective-binding equivalence remain required. Cross-row stale-display writes are not reproduced.

selected_writer_ownership.outcome: Prepare every selected typed option source before any selected writer; ignore invalid unselected sources and leave their choices untouched. Reuse existing Rows/local field loops with a mask, selected forced value projections, focused editable/caret deferral, readonly/group/Select/custom-render behavior and raw row context. Selected unbound refresh repaints only the selected existing empty/local view; full unbound refresh uses bind(null).
selected_writer_ownership.remaining: Only already compiled fields participate. Local/native reset behavior remains inherited; no new default, unbind, dynamic discovery or second binding engine is introduced.

migration.outcome: Map legacy full whole-row hooks to explicit observer options while preserving full raw source ownership in Rows. Replace legacy selective bind that changed row association before filtering fields with same-current-ID refresh. Exercise the existing CVC detail caller and document source/event/focus timing and scope boundaries.
migration.remaining: M5.7 live captured defaults/unbind, shared/global composition and dynamic discovery remain required; native defaults and Rows originals do not substitute for captured live defaults.

installed.outcome: Use one exact tarball in isolated JavaScript/TypeScript and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit/actual Windows Chrome/Edge, exercising the new whole observers/context and full/selected refresh through public handles with complete fresh three-engine coverage and unchanged performance budgets.
installed.remaining: No npm publication or release tag. Actual macOS/iOS Safari remains excluded; available WebKit and installed Windows Chrome/Edge remain mandatory.
